detail.title: Analysis of Counterfactual Scoring and Foundational Reasoning Limits
detail.summary: We examine the identification conditions of counterfactual scores for abstaining classifiers and their implications for detecting incorrect foundational premises in automated reasoning systems.
detail.reason: The project proj-assumption-falsification is synthesis-ready and requires a structured notebook connecting collected evidence on counterfactual scoring and cognitive augmentation to the question of automated premise correction.

detail.title: Challenging Foundational Assumptions in Automated Reasoning
detail.question: Can automated reasoning systems reliably detect and correct false foundational premises without external oversight?
detail.reason: Continuing active inquiry into automated assumption falsification using collected causal editing sources.

children.title: Cycle 7 · Investigating Automated Premise Correction and Counterfactual Scorer Limitations

detail.title: Investigating Automated Premise Correction and Counterfactual Scorer Limitations
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates foundational assumption falsification in automated reasoning systems, examining how abstention scoring and counterfactual estimation models behave under uncertainty using collected evidence sources.
